snippet.title: ♾️ Infinity Nikki Version 2.11 Outfit Preview: Snowbloom Wishsong
snippet.description:
♾️ Infinity Nikki Version 2.11 Outfit Preview: Snowbloom Wishsong

Soft snowdrifts pile up as frosting sugar swirls lightly in the air.
Bells jingle, and even the winter wind catches the taste of candy.
Warm blessings in hand, the gingerbread helper arrives safe and sound...
May joy dance down with the falling snow, and may no happiness ever melt away.

Main Attribute: Fresh
Outfit Ability: Unmelting Snow
After using the ability, Nikki glides gracefully with light, nimble steps. As she spins and leaps, snow begins to fall quietly all around her.
Nikki can summon a gingerbread helper to aid her on her journey. The gingerbread helper can fish, catch bugs, groom, and collect within a certain range around Nikki. Once summoned, she can switch between gingerbread helpers with different specialties. When Nikki switches to another ability, the gingerbread helper won't disappear.
There are four gingerbread helpers who prioritize their specialty, collecting preferred resources within range before moving on to others: strawberry excels at fishing, butter at bug-catching, chocolate at grooming, and matcha at collecting items. They will collect their preferred resources and return to Nikki when they finish collecting.
Note: Unmelting Snow cannot be used in indoor stages.

Decoration: Wishful Sweetness
Can be placed in open spaces. A wish is often born from the dream of finding a sweetness as delightful as candy. For even when disaster strikes, hope remains the most precious treasure of all.
❖ Available after reaching 160 Resonances in the limited-time Resonance "Snowfall, Softly Sung."

Evolution Rewards
◆ Evolving the outfit to Stage 1 unlocks the pose Soaring Wishes.
◆ Evolving the outfit to Stage 2 unlocks the Framed Moment item Snowy Wishes. You can also use Firstwish Heartchime: Wishful Sweetness in [Clothing Evolution - Decoration: Radiance] to obtain the decoration Wishful Sweetness: Radiance.
◆ Evolving the outfit to Stage 3 unlocks Wishfall Heart: Makeup, a new idle animation, multiple poses, enhanced special effects, and alternative details for certain pieces.

——
➤ Infinity Nikki Version 2.11 Tales Woven in Time launches globally on October 29 (UTC-7)!
